title: Endotypic Traits and Obstructive Sleep Apnea Surgery
official: Endotypic Traits and Obstructive Sleep Apnea Surgery
summary: This study will examine factors associated with outcomes after soft palate surgery and medications (acetazolamide, eszopiclone) that may treat other potential causes of obstructive sleep apnea (loop gain, arousal threshold).
